text: トライパスを　おもち　なのですね！

structure.jp: おもち　なのですね！

patterns.name: お〜だ
patterns.explanation: お plus the verb stem plus です is a very polite way to say what the customer is doing. おもち　なのです = 'you have (it)'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なのです adds the feeling of 'so it is that...', as if the speaker has just noticed something. おもち　なのですね = 'so you have one, I see'.
